sources.title: Evo Harness README.md
sources.finding: Documents local Rust engine and Tauri desktop, direct providers, plugins and WebBridge marked in development.

sources.title: Evo Harness LICENSE
sources.finding: Repository Apache-2.0 terms; external providers and plugins remain separate.

sources.title: Evo Harness docs/features/README.md
sources.finding: Source-control, WebBridge, plugin UI, code mode and other features retain in-progress labels; code graph is Draft. Status prose alone is not shipped evidence.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/args.rs
sources.finding: CLI exposes text/JSON/RPC modes, prompt/file attachments, provider/model/thinking, resume/export, offline-startup and trust controls. Offline startup is not network isolation.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/auth.rs
sources.finding: Persistent provider API-key and package-owned OAuth login/check/logout/refresh. Local readiness is not provider acceptance.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-runtime/src/credentials.rs
sources.finding: Provider-scoped stored API/OAuth, models.json, environment/header and anonymous credential resolution; refresh margin60s.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-mcp/src/config.rs
sources.finding: Stdio, Streamable HTTP and SSE MCP transports; headers/env credentials, disabled servers and tool permissions. Plugin minimal environment differs from ordinary server environment.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/plugin_settings.rs
sources.finding: Validated per-person/workspace settings, OS-keychain-backed plugin vault, optional permission grants/revocation and local plugin data removal.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/approval.rs
sources.finding: Ask/AutoEdits/Auto and chat-lived grants gate classified edits/commands after prior guards. Earlier blocks win; no UI blocks approval-required calls; desktop external tools have their own gate.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-tools/src/sandbox.rs
sources.finding: Guardrails default permissive with inherited environment. File-tool deny globs, shell timeout/output and subagent limits are configurable; shell can still read denied paths. No OS isolation follows from this class.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/trust.rs
sources.locator: project decision persistence and resource gating
sources.finding: Local project trust decisions control project resource loading; this does not constrain arbitrary approved shell execution.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/memory.rs
sources.finding: Personal/project Markdown memory indexes, provenance and timestamp, edits/deletion/reset; enabled and personal memory default on, sensitive subjects default off.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/tools/interaction.rs
sources.finding: Structured questions and transcript-backed replacement todo list. Todos are chat content, not a separate durable issue tracker.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-store/src/chats.rs
sources.finding: SQLite workspace/chat identity, parent relation, pin/archive/search metadata, usage totals and turn records; incognito omits searchable history and is removed when ended.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/tools/agent.rs
sources.finding: Foreground/background child agents, retained progress/report and follow-ups. Default4 running per session, configurable1–8; foreground waits/background refuses full slots. Children cannot delegate;30min timeout,16 retained per session/64 per engine. Lost background workers are reported after restart, not silently resumed.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/session_roles.rs
sources.finding: Nested sessions choose agent type/model/thinking; read-only roles narrow tools and propagate to children. These are agent roles, not organization roles.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/mesh.rs
sources.finding: Addressed session/agent messages, results, wait-cycle refusal, per-pair loop guard and child-first cascade cancellation. This is agent coordination, not a task dependency tracker.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/supervisor.rs
sources.locator: ensure; on_exit; attach_state; follow_line; idle trim
sources.finding: Desktop shell owns one engine per chat, generation fencing, working/idle state, persisted turns and question/approval notifications; windows attach as viewers. Crashed engines report stopped rather than preserving running subagents.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/agent_tools/scheduler/run.rs
sources.finding: Shell polls20s, stores latest30 runs, starts a chat per task, runs a missed schedule once after startup and skips overlapping busy prior chat. No vendor scheduler.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/agent_tools/scheduler/schedule.rs
sources.finding: Manual/once/hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly/5-field cron in local timezone.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-worktrees/src/lib.rs
sources.locator: Worktrees::create_named lines428–486; changes lines687–689; apply lines695–714; remove lines721 onward
sources.finding: Per-agent/session worktrees and branches; applying a reviewed patch checks expected changes hash, applies to target uncommitted and removes worktree. File separation is not process/network isolation.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/source_control.rs
sources.locator: resolve_target; scm operations; Discards; commit checks
sources.finding: Desktop stage/unstage/diff/discard/undo/commit/amend with repository-path checks;50 discard undo records live for app run. Active-run or published-amend confirmations are not CI/role authorization.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src/components/ai-elements/worktree-review.tsx
sources.finding: Human reviews worktree patch, Apply sends displayed changes hash; changed patches are refused and reloaded. Applies uncommitted files, not a hosted PR merge.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/checkpoints.rs
sources.finding: Git turn snapshots before/after runs; editing waits up to10s then proceeds with incomplete marker. Interrupted turns are closed incomplete on restart; revert preserves later-changed files via skipped outcomes.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/usage_log.rs
sources.finding: Local SQLite response usage for chat/subagent/plugin/side/memory, provider/model and cached/input/output tokens plus models.dev cost. Async writes drop a batch after3 failures; not an authoritative billing ledger.

sources.title: Evo Harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/plugin_ai/mod.rs
sources.finding: Per-plugin daily/monthly estimated USD prechecks, bounded concurrent calls/queue wait, permission-aware context/tools. These caps do not cover all ordinary chats.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/plugin_ai/run.rs
sources.locator: candidate fallback; budget checks lines528/846; request max tokens
sources.finding: Plugin run estimated cost and output-token bounds checked between calls, limited model fallback; one call may overshoot a prechecked spend cap.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-engine/src/export.rs
sources.finding: Markdown/HTML/JSONL transcript export, including live unsaved recovery messages; portable content is not live process migration.

sources.title: Evo Harness crates/evo-telemetry/src/production.rs
sources.finding: Structured telemetry is stdout/file/custom writer; no network uploader in this implementation. Bounded desktop/engine source search finds no PostHog/Sentry/analytics sender.

sources.title: Evo Harness scripts/readme-shots/README.md
sources.finding: Original app images load actual desktop UI in Chromium using fake Tauri IPC and canned messages/repository. Banner is a separate composite; neither proves execution or concurrency.

sources.title: Evo privacy policy v2.0
sources.locator: Desktop; website; security and retention; final draft note
sources.finding: Separates website (no analytics configured), desktop local data and optional providers, and WebBridge authorized tabs. Local data remains until user deletion or feature-specific removal; external services have their own terms. Page calls itself a product-operational draft pending legal/hosting review, not an audited guarantee.
